text: Россияне взяли в кредит почти ₽492 млрд наличными в августе В августе банки выдали гражданам ₽491,8 млрд наличными — это максимум за последние два года. title: Six green card holders in Texas charged in federal crackdown on illegal voting – as it happened
text: 18.06 EDT Six green card holders in Texas swept up in federal crackdown on illegal voting Earlier on Tuesday, Todd Blanche , the US attorney general, alerted reporters at the White House to stand by for what he called “a big development” in the federal crackdown on voting by non-citizens to be announced by Ryan Raybould , the US attorney for the Northern District of Texas. When it came, however, Raybould’s announcement , that his office had charged six lawful permanent residents and one undocumented immigrant for voting in federal elections over the past eight years, hardly lived up to the billing. While six of those charged cast ballots in the 2024 general election, the impact of their votes was almost immeasurably small, given that two of them cast provisional ballots that were not counted, and 11,388,670 other Texans voted in that election. Donald Trump , whose false claim that voting by non-citizens is rampant inspired the investigation, won the state by a margin of 1,558,347 votes over his nearest rival, Kamala Harris .
